# `play` operations

3 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### play.prepare

**Prepare Google Play release**

Verify and upload an AAB, stage a track update and validate the edit. Returns a reviewable edit ID; does not commit it.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `credentials` | string | yes |  | Owner-only Google service-account JSON |
| `package` | string | yes |  |  |
| `path` | string | yes |  |  |
| `track` | string |  | `"internal"` | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_:-]{1,100}` |
| `release_name` | string | yes |  | non-empty, up to 100 characters |
| `status` | string |  | `"draft"` | one of `draft`, `completed`, `inProgress` |
| `user_fraction` | number |  |  | 1e-06 to 0.999999 |
| `release_notes` | array of object |  |  | up to 100 items |
| `release_notes[].language` | string | yes |  | matching `[A-Za-z0-9-]{2,30}` |
| `release_notes[].text` | string | yes |  | up to 500 characters |

```sh
tomaccoctl call play.prepare '{"credentials":"<credentials>","package":"<package>","path":"<path>","release_name":"<release_name>"}'
```

### play.commit

**Commit Google Play change**

Commit an explicitly selected, previously prepared edit.

Annotations: **destructive**, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `credentials` | string | yes |  | Owner-only Google service-account JSON |
| `package` | string | yes |  |  |
| `edit_id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `changes_not_sent_for_review` | boolean |  | `false` |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call play.commit '{"credentials":"<credentials>","package":"<package>","edit_id":"<edit_id>"}'
```

### play.abort

**Discard Google Play draft**

Delete an uncommitted Google Play edit.

Annotations: **destructive**, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `credentials` | string | yes |  | Owner-only Google service-account JSON |
| `package` | string | yes |  |  |
| `edit_id` | string | yes |  |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call play.abort '{"credentials":"<credentials>","package":"<package>","edit_id":"<edit_id>"}'
```
